constructor.details: OZ v5 Ownable requires an explicit initialOwner constructor argument.

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions. Can only be called by the current owner. transferOwnership(address).details: Transfers ownership of the contract to a new account (`newOwner`). Can only be called by the current owner.

constructor.notice: Deploys SmokeImports, setting the deployer as the initial owner.

noOp().notice: No-op protected function — verifies ReentrancyGuard modifier compiles.

token().notice: A token reference — exists to ensure IERC20 import is used.
